subject: Eval extension request — surge pass vs cap credits
messages:
From: Liam Carter <liam.carter@vectorwave.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short extension request and packaging question

Grace —

Thanks again for the support during our eval. We ran into an unexpected data-set ingest delay and are about 9 business days behind schedule; the team is asking whether we can get a two-week extension on the timeboxed evaluation (currently set to close 2026-06-10).

Two asks from our side:
- Can you extend the trial window + keep the same SKU/seat pricing?
- If not, can we apply a short "surge pass" (one-time token bucket) to cover the extra consumption, or alternatively convert unused days to a token credit we can apply later?

We want to avoid a full re-contracting cycle if possible. Happy to sign a narrow addendum.

Attachment: VectorWave_POC_usage_report.xlsx (summary of current token burn / ETA)

—Liam
Director, ML Infrastructure
VectorWave
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@vectorwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short extension request and packaging question

Liam —

Appreciate the heads-up and the usage breakdown. We can absolutely avoid a full renegotiation. Two immediate options we can offer while I coordinate internally:

Option A — 14-day extension (no change to SKU) + conditional shortfall credits
- We extend the evaluation window by 14 days.
- If total token burn by the new end date exceeds the originally agreed allowance by >15%, we convert the overage to a one-time credit at 60% of list rate (applied to a future committed purchase).

Option B — Surge pass (one-time token bucket)
- One-time surge bucket equal to 30% of current remaining allowance, priced at a 20% discount off the pay-as-you-go rate.
- No change to trial end date.

I copied Marissa from Commercial for approval of the discount/credit mechanics and to advise on whether a simple addendum is enough (legal and finance gating). If either option looks good, reply here and I’ll get approval and a short addendum drafted.

Thanks,
Grace
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short extension request and packaging question

Grace / David —

Quick internal on the ask. We can approve a limited concession without exec signoff if we keep the exposure bounded and protect revenue. Proposed guardrails:

- Approve Option B (Surge pass) at 20% discount to PAYG for up to $12k of list value (i.e., our cost & margin are protected within that band).
- If customer chooses Option A (full 14-day extension), we will:
  * Approve a 0% immediate discount but apply a conversion rule where any overage becomes a credit at 60% of list applied to a future 6- or 12-month commit.
  * Require a signed 1-page addendum acknowledging the conversion rule and new end date.

Notes from Eng (David): the delay is mostly ingest-related; a short surge bucket is the least operational lift for us — we won't need to provision extra Dedicated capacity. If VectorWave later converts to Dedicated we'll revisit margins.

If Grace wants to push more discount for ARR coverage, we need to surface to Sales Ops (and possibly request a 1-off promo code).

Marissa
Commercial Director, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Quote_V2_20260531.pdf (internal pricing calc)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@vectorwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short extension request and packaging question

Liam —

Thanks for the patience. Short version: we can proceed without a full re-contract. Two formal options below — pick whichever you prefer and I’ll send a 1‑page addendum for signature.

Option 1 — Surge Pass (recommended)
- One-time token bucket sized to 30% of your remaining allowance, priced at a 20% discount to PAYG rates.
- Cap on Redwood's exposure: $12,000 list-value equivalent.
- No change to original end date (2026-06-10); tokens valid immediately.

Option 2 — 14-day extension
- Trial end date moved to 2026-06-24.
- No upfront discount; any overage beyond 15% of original allowance converts to a credit at 60% of list rate that can be applied to a future committed annual contract (6- or 12-month).
- Requires a signed addendum; no finance hold if signed within 48 hours.

Please reply with which option you want and confirm the PO/person who will sign the addendum if you choose Option 2. If you want me to draft the addendum now, I can attach it for signature.

Best —
Grace
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
